scenes.title: Look at You Grow
narration: Have you noticed how much taller you have grown since you were a baby?
Our bodies are amazing machines that help us run, jump, and play.
Do you ever wonder what is hiding under your skin?

scenes.title: Parts We Can See
narration: Outside, we have parts like our head, arms, and legs.
Our eyes help us see colorful kites in the sky.
Our ears help us hear the chirping birds in the park.
We use our hands to hold a yummy mango.

scenes.title: Parts Inside Us
narration: Deep inside, our heart beats like a little drum to keep us going.
Our lungs fill with air every time we take a deep breath.
Our stomach works hard to turn our lunch into energy.

scenes.title: Keep Your Body Happy
narration: To stay strong, eat healthy vegetables like spinach and carrots.
Remember to run and play to keep your muscles active.
Your body is very special because it belongs only to you.
Think about it: what is your favorite way to move your body?

scenes.title: Why Habits Matter
narration: Have you ever wondered why your teacher says brush your teeth twice?
Good habits help Rohan stay strong and happy every single day.
Let's learn how simple habits make you a superstar!

scenes.title: Building Good Habits
narration: First, wake up early and greet your family with a smile.
Always wash your hands with soap before you eat your yummy lunch.
Keep your school bag and books in the right place.
Doing these things every day makes them a habit.

scenes.title: A Day With Habits
narration: Look at Priya, she packs her bag before going to sleep.
She puts her dirty uniform in the basket, not on the floor.
By doing this, she feels relaxed and ready for school.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Good habits include staying clean, being tidy, and helping others.
Remember, a small habit today makes a big difference tomorrow.
Which new habit will you start practicing at home today?

scenes.title: Meet Your Unique Self
narration: Have you ever wondered why you love drawing but your friend loves cricket?
Everyone is different, and that is what makes you, you!
Let's explore why we like different things today.

scenes.title: Understanding Likes and Dislikes
narration: A like is something that makes your heart feel happy.
A dislike is just something you do not enjoy as much.
It is perfectly okay to have different favorites from your friends.

scenes.title: A Day With Aarav
narration: Aarav loves eating spicy idli for breakfast every morning.
But Aarav dislikes the sound of loud firecrackers during Diwali.
He tells his friends, and they respect his feelings.

scenes.title: You Are Amazing
narration: Your likes and dislikes show your own special personality.
Always be proud of what you enjoy doing.
Think about it: What is one thing you love that makes you smile?

scenes.title: Who Is In Your Family
narration: Do you live with your parents, grandparents, or siblings in your home?
A family is a group of people who love and care for each other.
Families come in all different shapes and sizes across India.

scenes.title: Types of Families
narration: A small family has parents and their children living together.
A big joint family includes grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins too.
Every family type is special because it is where you belong.

scenes.title: Meet Kabir and Aanya
narration: Kabir lives with just his mom and dad in a small apartment.
Aanya lives in a big house with her grandparents and many cousins.
Both Kabir and Aanya have families who help them every single day.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: Families can be small with parents or big with many relatives.
The most important thing in any family is love and support.
Think about it: What is one fun thing you like doing with your family?

Myself: My Name, Age and Interests.topic: Myself: My Name, Age and Interests
Myself: My Name, Age and Interests.title: Who Are You Today?

scenes.title: Meet Your New Friend
narration: Hello! Have you ever thought about what makes you, you?
Every person is special and has their own name.
Do you know your name and how old you are?

scenes.title: What Makes You Special
narration: Your name is like a tag that tells people who you are.
Your age tells us how many birthdays you have celebrated.
You are growing taller and learning new things every day!

scenes.title: My Favorite Things
narration: Aarav loves playing cricket in the park with his friends.
Meera loves painting bright pictures of mangoes and flowers.
What is one thing you love to do most?

scenes.title: You Are One Of A Kind
narration: Your name, age, and interests make you unique.
There is nobody else exactly like you in the whole world.
Think about it: what is the best thing about being you?

scenes.title: Who Is In Your Family
narration: Look at this happy photo of Rohan and his family at home.
Do you live with your parents, siblings, or grandparents too?
Have you ever wondered how everyone is connected to you?

scenes.title: Learning Our Family Roles
narration: Your parents are the ones who take care of you every day.
Grandparents are your parents' parents, and they share the best stories.
Siblings are your brothers and sisters who play games with you.
A family is like a team where everyone helps each other out.

scenes.title: Rohan's Family Example
narration: Rohan lives with his Aaji, his Baba, his Aai, and his sister Sia.
They eat breakfast together before Rohan and Sia go to school.
In the evening, Aaji helps them with homework and tells them tales.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Families are the special people who love and support us always.
We have different family members who play different roles in our lives.
Can you draw your family tree and name everyone in it?

scenes.title: Who is in your family?
narration: Look around your home, do you see your parents and siblings?
Have you ever wondered why we call these special people family?
A family is a group of people who love and care for us.

scenes.title: Learning the family members
narration: We have parents, who are our mother and our father.
You might also have brothers and sisters, who are your siblings.
Some families live with grandparents, aunts, uncles, and cousins too.

scenes.title: A fun day with Aarav
narration: Meet Aarav, he is having lunch with his family in Delhi.
His grandmother serves delicious parathas for everyone to share.
Aarav helps his father clear the table while his sister plays.

scenes.title: Family is everything
narration: Families come in all shapes and sizes and are always special.
We help each other, learn together, and grow up happy.
Think about it, what is one kind thing you can do for your family today?

My Home: Rooms in a House.topic: My Home: Rooms in a House
My Home: Rooms in a House.title: Exploring My Cozy Home

scenes.title: Welcome to My Home
narration: Look around your house, how many different rooms can you find?
Every room has a special job to do for our family.
Let us take a tour of Rahul's home in Delhi.

scenes.title: Rooms and Their Uses
narration: In the bedroom, we sleep on a soft bed at night.
In the kitchen, mom cooks yummy dal and rice.
The bathroom is where we brush our teeth and wash.
We sit in the living room to talk and play games.

scenes.title: Rahul's Daily Routine
narration: Rahul wakes up in his bedroom feeling very happy.
He goes to the bathroom to wash his face.
Then he eats breakfast with his family in the kitchen.
Finally he plays with his toys in the living room.

scenes.title: Keep Your Home Tidy
narration: A house has different rooms for sleeping, eating, and relaxing.
Always keep your room tidy by putting toys away.
Which room in your house is your favorite place to be?

scenes.title: A Helpful Home
narration: Have you ever seen your family working together at home?
Our family is like a team that takes care of us.
How can we help make our home a happy place?

scenes.title: Little Helpers
narration: You can help by keeping your toys in a basket.
Try placing your shoes neatly near the front door.
Bringing your empty plate to the kitchen is very helpful.

scenes.title: A Helping Day
narration: Aarav helps his Dadi by finding her reading glasses.
He also helps his mother water the green plants.
His family feels so happy because he is a helper.

scenes.title: You Are A Star
narration: Helping makes our family bond strong and full of love.
Remember, even small tasks make a big difference.
What kind thing will you do for your family today?

My Home: Different Types of Homes.topic: My Home: Different Types of Homes
My Home: Different Types of Homes.title: Why Do Houses Look Different?

scenes.title: A Look At Our Homes
narration: Look around your street, do all houses look exactly the same?
Some are tall buildings and some are small huts.
Let us find out why houses are built in different ways.

scenes.title: Understanding Home Types
narration: A Kucha house is made of mud, straw, and wood.
A Pucca house is made of strong bricks, cement, and steel.
People choose materials based on where they live and the weather.

scenes.title: Examples In India
narration: In cold mountains, houses have sloping roofs so snow slides off easily.
In sunny Rajasthan, thick mud walls keep the inside cool.
In big cities like Mumbai, tall apartments save space for many people.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Homes keep us safe from rain, heat, and cold.
Different materials like mud or bricks make different houses.
Think about it, what material is your own house made of?

My Home: Keeping the Home Clean.topic: My Home: Keeping the Home Clean
My Home: Keeping the Home Clean.title: Keeping Our Home Happy

scenes.title: A Tidy Home is Fun
narration: Do you like playing in a messy room or a neat one?
A clean home keeps us healthy and happy every day.
Let us learn how to keep our homes shining like new.

scenes.title: Sorting Our Belongings
narration: First, put your toys back into the toy box.
Put dirty clothes into the laundry basket, please.
Books should always go neatly on the shelf.
Everything has a special home of its own.

scenes.title: A Quick Cleaning Routine
narration: Aarav helps his mother by dusting the table.
Next, use a broom to sweep the floor clean.
Finally, throw dry waste into the blue dustbin.

scenes.title: Keep It Shining
narration: Clean rooms mean fewer germs and more play time.
Make cleaning a part of your daily routine.
What is one thing you will clean today?

scenes.title: The Big School Gate
narration: Have you ever wondered why we go to school every morning?
School is a special place where we learn new things together.
Let us see who makes our school so much fun.

scenes.title: Our Helpful Teachers
narration: Teachers are like guides who help us learn to read and write.
They teach us how to count numbers like one, two, and three.
They also teach us to be kind to all our friends.

scenes.title: Friends in the Classroom
narration: Meet Rohan and Meera, who sit at the same wooden desk.
They share their crayons to color a beautiful map of India.
When they play, they learn to take turns on the swing.

scenes.title: Why School is Great
narration: In school, teachers lead and students learn with happy hearts.
We grow smarter and kinder every single day we attend.
Think about it: what is your favorite thing to do at school?

scenes.title: Welcome to School
narration: Do you ever wonder why we go to school every morning?
School is a special place where we learn new things together.
Let's explore what happens inside our lovely classroom.

scenes.title: Learning in Class
narration: First, we sit at our desks with our notebooks and pencils.
Our teacher writes fun lessons on the big blackboard.
We read colorful stories about India and the world.
We practice counting numbers like one, two, and three.

scenes.title: Playing with Friends
narration: Now it is time for the exciting lunch break.
Rohan shares his yummy paratha with his best friend Meera.
We run and play tag in the grassy school playground.

scenes.title: Recap and Reflect
narration: At school, we learn lessons, make friends, and play.
Every day is a new chance to grow smarter.
Think about it: what is your favorite part of your school day?

scenes.title: The Curious Home Explorer
narration: Welcome home, Rohan! Did you know your house has many hidden safety rules?
Have you ever wondered why we shouldn't touch the kitchen stove?
Let us learn how to keep ourselves safe while playing inside.

scenes.title: Three Big Safety Rules
narration: First, never touch electrical plugs with wet hands to avoid a shock.
Second, stay away from sharp knives and scissors in the kitchen drawer.
Third, never open the main door to a stranger you do not know.
Following these rules makes your home a happy place for everyone.

scenes.title: Rohan's Safety Check
narration: Look, Rohan sees a spill of water on the smooth bathroom floor.
He knows he could slip, so he tells his mother right away.
Mom cleans it up quickly, and now the floor is dry again.

scenes.title: Wrap Up and Think
narration: Remember, always keep floors dry and stay away from dangerous tools.
If you see something unsafe, tell a trusted adult immediately.
Think about it: What is one thing you can do today to keep your home safe?

scenes.title: Why Do We Have Rules
narration: Have you ever wondered why school has so many rules?
Rules help everyone stay safe and happy together.
Like a game, rules make sure everyone gets a turn.

scenes.title: Learning Our Classroom Rules
narration: In class, we raise our hand to speak.
We listen quietly when our teacher talks.
We walk slowly in the hallway to stay safe.
We treat our friends with kindness every day.

scenes.title: An Example of Following Rules
narration: Meet Rohan, he wants to borrow a crayon.
He asks his friend politely for it.
His friend says yes and shares happily.

scenes.title: Recapping Our School Life
narration: Rules keep our school a fun place to learn.
Being kind and listening makes you a superstar.
What is one rule you will follow today?

scenes.title: Meeting School Helpers
narration: Welcome to school! Who keeps our classroom clean and safe every day?
Our school is like a big team working together for us.
Let's meet the friendly people who make our learning possible.

scenes.title: The People Who Help
narration: The teacher guides us in learning new things in class.
The principal makes sure our school runs smoothly for everyone.
The security guard keeps us safe at the school gate.
The cleaning staff works hard to keep our floors shiny.

scenes.title: A Morning at School
narration: First, Uncle Raju opens the gate with a big smile.
Then, our teacher greets us and starts our morning lesson.
After lunch, the helpers clean the area so it is tidy.

scenes.title: Thanking Our Helpers
narration: Many people work together to help us learn and play.
Always remember to say thank you to these kind helpers.
Who is one helper you want to thank today?

scenes.title: Welcome to our neighbourhood
narration: Have you ever wondered who makes our neighbourhood special?
There are so many helpful places right outside our door.
Let us take a walk and see what we find!

scenes.title: Important places we visit
narration: The school is where we go to learn new things.
When we feel sick, the clinic helps us feel better.
We visit the market to buy fresh vegetables and milk.
Parks are fun places to play with our friends.

scenes.title: A trip to the shop
narration: Rohan goes to the shop with ten rupees.
He picks a packet of healthy biscuits.
He pays the shopkeeper with his coins.
Now he has a yummy snack to eat at home.

scenes.title: Recap and think
narration: Our neighbourhood has schools, shops, and parks.
These places help us learn, stay healthy, and play.
Can you name one place in your street you visit often?

scenes.title: The People Next Door
narration: Look out your window, who lives right next to your home?
The people living near us are called our neighbours.
Do you know their names or what they do?

scenes.title: Living Together Happily
narration: Neighbours are like a big team living in one street.
We share space like parks, shops, and lanes.
Being kind helps everyone stay happy and safe.

scenes.title: A Helpful Neighbourhood
narration: Aarav lives next door and helps water the plants.
Mrs. Sharma shares her yummy laddoos during festivals.
When we help each other, our street feels like family.

scenes.title: Being A Good Neighbour
narration: Remember, we all make a neighbourhood great together.
Always be polite and keep your surroundings clean.
How can you be a helpful neighbour today?

scenes.title: The Hook: Everyday Shops
narration: Do you need milk or a notebook for school today?
Look around your street, there are many shops waiting for us!
Have you ever wondered how these shops help our community?

scenes.title: Learning About Local Shops
narration: A grocer sells fresh food like dal, rice, and spices.
A stationery shop keeps your colourful pens and books ready.
A chemist shop provides medicines to keep us feeling strong.
We use rupees to pay for the things we need.

scenes.title: Example: A Visit to Mrs. Sharma
narration: Let us visit Mrs. Sharma at her busy fruit stall.
We choose three shiny red apples for our snack.
We give her ten rupees and she says thank you!
Mrs. Sharma smiles and hands over our healthy apples.

scenes.title: Recap and Final Thought
narration: Our neighbourhood shops give us food, books, and medicine.
The shopkeepers are our friends who make life easy.
Think about it: What is your favourite shop in your street?

scenes.title: Meet Your Friendly Police Station
narration: Have you seen a police station while walking to school?
It is a special place where our helpers work.
Do you wonder what they do all day?

scenes.title: Keeping Us Safe Every Day
narration: Police officers keep our neighbourhood safe and happy.
They help people find their way if they are lost.
They make sure the traffic moves smoothly on the road.
When there is trouble, they are the first to help.

scenes.title: A Day at the Station
narration: Imagine Rohan lost his cricket ball in the busy market.
He tells a friendly officer exactly what happened.
The officer calls the market guard to look for it.
Soon, Rohan gets his ball back with a smile!

scenes.title: Remembering Our Helpers
narration: Police stations keep our community safe and peaceful.
They are our brave friends in uniform.
Can you wave hello to a police officer today?

scenes.title: Meeting a Local Doctor
narration: Have you ever felt poorly and visited a friendly clinic nearby?
The person who helps us feel better is a doctor.
Let us see what they do in our neighborhood.

scenes.title: How Doctors Help Us
narration: First, the doctor listens to your heart with a stethoscope.
They check your throat and ears to find the problem.
Then, they write a prescription for the medicine you need.
This helps your body fight off the sickness quickly.

scenes.title: A Visit to Dr. Priya
narration: Little Rahul visits Dr. Priya's clinic in Delhi today.
He has a cough, so she checks his chest carefully.
She gives him a syrup and tells him to rest.
Rahul feels much safer knowing she is there to help.

scenes.title: Recap and Big Question
narration: Doctors keep us healthy by checking our bodies regularly.
They give us medicine to help us fight germs.
Think about it: How can you help a friend who is feeling sick today?

scenes.title: A Visit to the Doctor
narration: Have you ever felt sick and gone to see a kind doctor?
Our neighbourhood hospital is a very special place for everyone.
Let us see who works there to keep us healthy.

scenes.title: Who Works at the Hospital
narration: Doctors check our heartbeats and listen to our breathing.
Nurses give us our medicine and help us feel better.
Receptionists help us find the right room when we arrive.

scenes.title: Checking Little Ravi
narration: Little Ravi went to the hospital with a sore throat.
The doctor used a stethoscope to hear his chest clearly.
Ravi took his medicine and soon felt happy again.

scenes.title: Staying Healthy Together
narration: Hospitals are important places that keep our community strong.
Remember to thank the doctors who work very hard.
Think about it: What can you do to stay healthy?

scenes.title: The Friendly Neighborhood Helper
narration: Have you seen an officer in a crisp uniform standing at the busy road crossing?
Do you ever wonder how they help us stay safe while we play or go to school?
Let us learn how these brave friends keep our community happy and protected every single day.

scenes.title: What Do Police Officers Do?
narration: Police officers are special helpers who make sure everyone follows the laws to keep us safe.
They help people find their way if they are lost in a big market or park.
They also help control traffic so cars and buses can move safely on the roads.
If there is an emergency, they are the first ones to arrive and offer help.

scenes.title: A Day With Officer Rohan
narration: Meet Officer Rohan, who starts his morning by checking the busy streets of Delhi.
He helps a little girl cross the road safely on her way to get some jalebis.
He smiles and waves at the school bus, making sure all the children feel happy.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Police officers help with traffic, keep us safe, and are always there to help us.
They work very hard to keep our neighborhoods and our beautiful country peaceful.
Think about it: how can you show kindness to a police officer you see today?

scenes.title: Why Visit the Park
narration: Have you ever played in the park near your house with your friends?
The park is a special place where we can run, jump, and play.
What makes a park so important for our whole neighbourhood?

scenes.title: What Makes a Park
narration: Parks have tall green trees that give us cool shade.
There are bright flowers and green grass everywhere you look.
Parks also have swings and slides for us to enjoy.
We even see beautiful birds flying in the sky above.

scenes.title: A Day at the Park
narration: Rohan goes to the park with his family after school.
He walks on the path and sees a gardener watering plants.
Rohan sits on a bench and eats a yummy apple.
He makes sure to put his trash in the bin.

scenes.title: Keeping Our Park Happy
narration: Parks give us fresh air and a space to be happy.
We must keep our park clean by not dropping litter.
Think about it: what is your favorite game to play at the park?

scenes.title: Meeting a Local Hero
narration: Have you seen a big red truck rushing through the streets of India?
That is the fire brigade on a very important mission.
Who are these people who help us when there is danger?

scenes.title: What Firefighters Do
narration: Firefighters are trained experts who put out dangerous fires.
They wear heavy protective suits to stay safe from heat.
They also rescue people and animals stuck in high places.

scenes.title: A Day at the Station
narration: When the alarm rings, Rohan the firefighter slides down the pole.
He jumps into the truck with his team ready to go.
They use long hoses to spray water on the fire quickly.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Helpers
narration: Firefighters are brave, fast, and always ready to serve our community.
We should always thank them for keeping our homes safe.
Think about it, what would you do to keep your home fire-safe?

scenes.title: Meeting Our Teacher
narration: Have you noticed how your teacher helps you learn new things every day at school?
A teacher is a community helper who guides us on our exciting learning journey.
Why is a teacher so important for our neighborhood?

scenes.title: What Teachers Do
narration: Teachers explain numbers so we can count our marbles or buy snacks with rupees.
They teach us to read stories about brave heroes and faraway places in India.
Teachers also show us how to be kind and share with our classmates.
They keep us safe and help us solve problems when we get stuck.

scenes.title: A Day With Priya Ma'am
narration: Look at Priya Ma'am helping Rohan learn his Hindi alphabet letters today.
She draws a colorful map of India on the board for the whole class.
Then, she cheers loudly when everyone finishes their math worksheet correctly.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Teachers
narration: Teachers help us grow, learn, and become better friends in our community.
They work hard every single day to make our future bright.
Think about it: What is one nice thing you can say to your teacher tomorrow?

Transport: Road, Rail, Air and Water Tra.topic: Transport: Road, Rail, Air and Water Transport
Transport: Road, Rail, Air and Water Tra.title: How Do We Travel Around?

scenes.title: The Big Question
narration: Have you ever wondered how we travel to far away places?
We use many different types of transport to get around India.
Let's discover how we move on land, water, and in the air!

scenes.title: Moving On Land
narration: On land, we travel by road in cars, buses, and rickshaws.
We also have trains that run on tracks to carry many people.
Trains are great for long trips across our beautiful states.

scenes.title: Water And Air
narration: To cross rivers or the sea, we use big boats and ships.
For very fast travel, we fly high up in airplanes.
A plane can take you from Delhi to Mumbai very quickly!

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: We use roads, tracks, water, and air to reach our destinations.
Each type of transport helps us connect with friends and family.
Think about it: If you could go anywhere tomorrow, would you fly or take a train?

scenes.title: Who Grows Our Food?
narration: Have you ever wondered where your yummy lunch comes from?
It starts in the fields with a hardworking person called a farmer.
Let us see how they help us every single day.

scenes.title: Steps To Grow Crops
narration: First, the farmer prepares the soil so it is soft and ready.
Then, they carefully plant tiny seeds into the earth.
They give the plants water and sunshine to help them grow big.
Finally, when plants are ready, the farmer harvests the food.

scenes.title: From Farm To Kitchen
narration: Rohan sees the farmer picking golden wheat in the field.
The wheat is taken to the market in a big truck.
Mother buys fresh flour to make soft rotis for dinner.

scenes.title: Thank You Farmers
narration: Farmers work hard to make sure we always have enough to eat.
We should always say thank you for our healthy food.
Think about it: what is your favorite vegetable grown by a farmer?

scenes.title: A Surprise in the Mail
narration: Have you ever wondered who brings a letter to your front door?
It is our friendly neighborhood postman who walks the streets every day.
Let us see how he travels all the way to your house.

scenes.title: How the Mail Travels
narration: First, letters go to the local post office to be sorted.
The postman groups them by street and house number.
He packs them safely into his big leather bag.
Then, he starts his journey across the city.

scenes.title: Rohan Gets a Letter
narration: Look, the postman is riding his bicycle toward Rohan’s house.
He checks the address on the envelope carefully.
He drops the letter right into the blue mailbox.
Rohan is so happy to receive his special birthday card!

scenes.title: Helping Our Community
narration: Postmen work hard in all kinds of weather to connect people.
Remember to thank them for keeping us connected to our friends.
Think about it: what would you write in a letter to a friend?

scenes.title: The Busy Road
narration: Have you seen cars and bikes rushing to school in the morning?
The road is very busy, so how do we stay safe?
We follow special rules called traffic rules!

scenes.title: The Traffic Light
narration: Look at the traffic light at the corner.
Red means stop your vehicle right away.
Yellow means wait and be ready to move.
Green means it is safe to go forward.

scenes.title: Crossing the Street
narration: Aman wants to cross the road to buy a mango.
He always walks on the striped zebra crossing.
He looks right, then left, then right again.
Only when the road is empty does he walk.

scenes.title: Remember the Rules
narration: Always follow the lights and use the zebra crossing.
Being careful keeps you and your friends safe.
Can you spot a traffic light on your way home today?

scenes.title: The Busy Street Hook
narration: Do you see many cars and rickshaws outside your school today?
How do we cross the road without getting hurt?
Let us learn how to be super safe pedestrians!

scenes.title: Learning Safety Rules
narration: Always look for the zebra crossing with white stripes.
Wait for the green man light before you walk.
Hold an adult's hand firmly when you step out.

scenes.title: Crossing The Road Example
narration: Arav stands at the edge of the road near the market.
He looks right, then left, then right again to check cars.
When the road is empty, he walks across calmly.

scenes.title: Recap And Think
narration: Remember to use the zebra crossing and hold hands.
Always check for cars by looking both ways twice.
Think about it: Why should we never run on the road?

Festivals and Celebrations: Religious an.topic: Festivals and Celebrations: Religious and Cultural Festivals
Festivals and Celebrations: Religious an.title: Why Do We Celebrate Festivals?

scenes.title: The Joy of Celebrating
narration: Do you love the bright lights and yummy sweets during festivals?
Today we will learn why we celebrate these special days.
Festivals bring our families and friends together to be happy.

scenes.title: What Makes a Festival?
narration: Festivals are days we remember special stories or events.
Some festivals celebrate the seasons like the harvest time.
We wear beautiful new clothes and decorate our homes.

scenes.title: A Special Indian Celebration
narration: Think of Diwali, the festival of lights in India.
We light many diyas to make our homes glow.
We share delicious sweets like laddus with our neighbors.
It is a time to be kind and help others.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Traditions
narration: Festivals teach us about our culture and our past.
They remind us to love our family and friends.
What is your favorite festival to celebrate at home?

scenes.title: Why Do We Celebrate?
narration: Have you ever wondered why we have so many fun festivals in India?
Festivals are special days when we share joy with our friends and neighbors.
Let us see how celebrating together makes our hearts happy.

scenes.title: The Magic of Sharing
narration: During festivals, we clean our homes and decorate them with bright colors.
We wear beautiful new clothes to look our very best.
The best part is sharing delicious sweets with everyone we know.

scenes.title: A Day at Diwali
narration: Imagine it is Diwali, the festival of lights.
Aarav helps his family light small clay lamps called diyas.
He shares a box of yummy laddoos with his friend Priya next door.
They play together and smile because the festival brings them closer.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: We celebrate to share happiness, help others, and show love.
Every festival is a chance to be kind and friendly.
Think about it: What is your favorite festival and who do you share it with?

scenes.title: Welcome to Our Home
narration: Look at our map with many colors.
Have you ever wondered why India is so special?
Let us take a fun trip to see it all.

scenes.title: Land and People
narration: India has tall snowy mountains in the north.
Down south, we have beautiful blue oceans.
People here speak many different languages.
We all live together as one big family.

scenes.title: Colors of India
narration: See the bright colors during Diwali festival.
We love eating yummy snacks like samosas.
Our national bird is the peacock with pretty feathers.
Our flag has three stripes of color.

scenes.title: Remembering Our India
narration: India is a huge land with mountains and seas.
We are proud to live in this country.
Think about it, what is your favorite part of India?

scenes.title: Why celebrate special days
narration: Have you seen our bright tricolor flag flying high on school buildings?
Today we will learn why we celebrate special days for our whole country.
These are called National Festivals, and they make everyone in India happy!

scenes.title: Our important days
narration: On 15th August, we celebrate Independence Day when India became free.
On 26th January, we celebrate Republic Day with a big parade in Delhi.
We also celebrate Gandhi Jayanti on 2nd October to remember Mahatma Gandhi.
Each of these days tells a special story about our home, India.

scenes.title: Celebrating at school
narration: At school, we gather in the morning to sing our beautiful National Anthem.
Teachers tell us stories about brave heroes who worked hard for us.
We wear clean clothes and decorate our classrooms with balloons and flowers.
Everyone feels proud to be part of our big, wonderful family.

scenes.title: Remembering our festivals
narration: National festivals remind us that we are all one big team.
We honor our flag, our history, and our leaders on these days.
Think about it: What is your favorite part of celebrating Independence Day?

scenes.title: Seeing Our Flag
narration: Have you seen our flag flying high at your school?
It is called the Tiranga, which means three colors.
Do you know what these colors tell us?

scenes.title: Colors and Meaning
narration: Saffron at the top stands for courage and strength.
White in the middle stands for peace and truth.
Green at the bottom stands for our land's greenery.

scenes.title: The Special Wheel
narration: Look at the blue wheel in the center.
It is called the Ashoka Chakra with 24 spokes.
It represents moving forward steadily like a wheel.

scenes.title: Respecting Our Flag
narration: The Tiranga is the proud symbol of India.
We must always respect it and keep it clean.
Where else have you seen the flag flying today?

scenes.title: Meeting Our National Symbols
narration: Have you seen our bright flag waving at your school?
These are special symbols that show how much we love India.
Today, let us learn about the things that make India proud.

scenes.title: Flag and Animal
narration: Our flag has three colors: saffron, white, and green.
In the middle, there is a blue wheel called the Ashoka Chakra.
Our national animal is the strong and beautiful Royal Bengal Tiger.
The tiger lives in our deep, green forests.

scenes.title: Flower and Bird
narration: Look at the lovely Lotus flower in the pond.
The Lotus stands for purity and beauty.
The Peacock is our national bird with colorful feathers.
When it rains, the peacock dances with its feathers wide open.

scenes.title: Recap and Think
narration: We learned about our flag, the tiger, the lotus, and the peacock.
These symbols bring all Indians together as one big family.
Can you draw your favorite national symbol today?

scenes.title: A Special Morning Song
narration: Have you heard this beautiful song at your school assembly?
It is called Jana Gana Mana, our National Anthem.
Why do we stand still and listen so carefully?

scenes.title: The Meaning of Our Anthem
narration: Our anthem was written by Rabindranath Tagore long ago.
It celebrates the beauty and unity of our country.
Every word praises the rivers and lands of India.

scenes.title: How to Show Respect
narration: When the music starts, stop playing and stand tall.
Keep your hands at your sides and face forward.
We stay quiet to show we love our country.

scenes.title: Remembering Our Pride
narration: Jana Gana Mana makes us all feel like one family.
We stand together to honor our beautiful nation.
Can you name one other national symbol of India?
